title: Gotham Knights
notes: This is quite the find! Work super well out of the box and can see compatibility has been focusing really hard to get DX12 titles like this to work well on a base M1. Initial load of the game takes awhile, you have to be patient as it seems like it is hung before getting to the initial copyright screen. Once it's loaded, one of the most impressive cinematics I've ever seen and it transitions effortlessly to 3D gameplay. on an M1, I lowered graphics settings to low to get an avg 25-35 fps. Everything is animated so well and the controls are good - not sure how I overlooked this one in my library! I am curious if this is the same team that did the Arkham series? Fun playing Batgirl! 🦇
